name: Fix a typo in user-facing copy
description: Change a single word or punctuation mark in a UI string. No logic change, no test change, no migration.
why_this_score: The smallest tech change that delivers value to the user. One file, one line, zero decisions.

name: Send a templated status update email
description: Fill in a pre-existing template with project-specific data and send to the client. No drafting, no new content creation.
why_this_score: The smallest bizdev task that delivers value. One template, one send, zero decisions.

name: Fix a broken local dev config
description: Change 3 lines across 3 config files to fix npm run dev. No logic, no test, no research.
why_this_score: Same caliber as a typo fix but in tooling - one fix, zero decisions.

name: Pin tool versions in config files
description: Drop two config files (.nvmrc, .tool-versions) to pin node/npm versions. No logic, no test.
why_this_score: Pure config, no decisions, no side effects.

name: Add tracking properties to Notion DB and record in skill
description: Add 4 text properties to DB schema + update one skill file to write them during status transitions. Static mapping, no logic.
why_this_score: Two mechanical edits (schema + skill), more than a glance but still one sitting.

name: Add a CI gate (license, security, or lint check)
description: New CI workflow file + config. Follows pattern from existing workflows, adapts for the specific check.
why_this_score: Self-contained, follows a template. Slightly more than config-only (1 pt) because it needs workflow + integration verification.

name: New UI screen with static layout and navigation wiring
description: New screen component, stylesheet, route registration, navigation wiring from Figma. Layout-only, no API calls or complex state.
why_this_score: Requires visual layout decisions and file structure setup. Bounded: single screen, no API, no shared state. More than schema edits (2) but less than full feature (5).

name: Set up GitHub Actions CI pipeline for a new repo
description: Multiple workflow files, environment config, test/lint/build jobs for a new repository.
why_this_score: Cross-cutting setup across multiple workflow files but each is formulaic. More than one gate (2) but less than feature work (5).

name: Feature screen with dynamic content, first in its domain
description: Full screen establishing UI patterns (theme, typography, layout components) with navigation and visual layout from Figma. Sets conventions for subsequent screens.
why_this_score: Crosses multiple concerns (UI patterns, theme, navigation) and establishes precedent for the codebase. Approaches daily speed limit.

name: Automated system with scheduled execution and data pipeline
description: Multiple databases, cron job, data aggregation logic, generated chart/report. Each piece is small but the integration surface demands sustained attention.
why_this_score: Multiple moving parts (schema, automation, computation, visualization). At daily speed ceiling.

name: Research, evaluate, and propose a plan from 10+ options
description: Evaluate 10+ candidates against criteria (budget, capacity, logistics), produce structured comparison table, recommend one option with backup.
why_this_score: Significant research volume with structured decision output. Fills a full working session.

name: Feature with navigation architecture and multiple child screens
description: Sidebar navigation, multiple screens, shared layout components, state management across child routes. Exceeds daily speed - should have been split.
why_this_score: Exceeds daily speed (5 pts). Recognition anchor: should be split into navigation (3) + individual screens (2-3 each).

name: Full auth flow: API client, tokens, session persistence
description: API transport layer, endpoint factories, token refresh, secure session storage, navigation guards, error handling. Multiple services across 54 files.
why_this_score: Way beyond daily speed. Should be an epic of 4-5 tickets: API client (3), token management (3), session persistence (3), navigation guards (2).
